outfit.name: 萨米荒野机能猎装（默认）
outfit.prose: A black mechanical goggle hairband, a fitted sleeveless white tactical top under a black corset harness with a crimson chest emblem, mismatched detached wide sleeves, black gloves, a black pleated overskirt over short black shorts with a belt pouch, fur-trimmed thighhigh socks, and lace-up black combat boots.
